a: XML is a markup language for structured data using tags.
YAML is a human-readable data format often used for configs.
TOML is a minimal config file format (used by many Rust and Python tools).
CSV stores tabular data as comma-separated values in plain text.
Protocol Buffers are a compact binary serialization format by Google.
Apache Avro is a binary data serialization system used in data pipelines.
Base64 encodes binary data as ASCII text for safe transport.
UTF-8 is the dominant character encoding for Unicode text on the web.
Unicode is a standard that assigns codes to characters from many languages.
A MIME type labels content format, e.g. application/json or image/png.
Content-Type: application/json means the body is JSON.
multipart/form-data is used to upload files and form fields in one HTTP request.
gzip compresses data to reduce transfer size.
A schema defines the structure and types of data (JSON Schema, DB schema, etc.).
